answer: Standing decays sharply after 7 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The harbor decay curve is applied at each close, grove records the drop, and ledge recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. That is 542 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
